correctness.rationale: The pair-overlap classes (identical, shared possible edge, edge-disjoint) partition every ordered pair of vertex triples. Exact q_r inclusion probabilities yield the moment formula; its algebraic factorization is checked and has strictly positive residual factor at every feasible nondegenerate m. The separate G(n,p) overlap covariance gives one linear sign threshold. All n>=4 boundary counts are handled. Exact direct enumeration for n=4,5,6 and 14,456 rational comparisons support but do not replace this proof.

value.rationale: The sign is uniformly negative for the natural conditioned motif census while its independent-edge analog changes sign at an exact density threshold. This is a complete dependence distinction in a canonical model and matters when graphlet-count diagnostics condition on observed edge density. The n^3 versus n^4 scale distinction is another structural consequence; novelty does not rest on numerical magnitude alone.
